# ovirt_nics (Data Source)

The ovirt_nics data source returns a set of all network interfaces attached to a virtual machine.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) oVirt ID of the VM to list the network interfaces for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nics` (Set of Object) Set of network interfaces attached to the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nics))

<a id="nestedatt--nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nics`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `mac` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `vnic_profile_id` (String)
